cohort_role: inspected development only; never independent confirmation again

decision_logic.first_question: Does occurrence-conditioned environmental support beat random at realistic low budgets before random geographic coverage saturates?
decision_logic.if_no_low_budget_lift: Abandon the current cell-level environmental-ranking family for generalization.
decision_logic.if_low_budget_lift_then_saturation: Move to equal-surveyed-area compact patch or route-time selection; do not use isolated-cell count as field budget.
decision_logic.confirmation: Any revised method must be frozen and tested on a newly predeclared cohort excluding these 16 taxa and the frozen 192 Practical Core taxa.

hard_boundaries: Do not retune or relabel the failed Campanula transfer as validation.
Do not consume the frozen 192-pair Practical Core cohort.
No existing-tool superiority claim in this development stage.
